barrier_group: CAPABILITY PER TOKEN (of the produced model)

verdicts.reason: No receipted 27B-class locally-reproduced baseline validation exists. External benchmarks (eval-suite-v1) are pinned but unvalidated against served models. This is a genuine gap in capability-per-token measurement infrastructure.
verdicts.covering_evidence: Audit claims eval-reference receipts ABSENT; no issue filed for baseline runs; docs/spec/eval-suite-freeze-v1.md exists but receipts/ directory empty of baseline runs

decisive_experiment.intervention: Run n-gram/PPM byte-level backoff baseline decoder on frozen eval-suite-v1 (7 datasets, 25k items, parameter-golf guidance)
decisive_experiment.measurement: NLL per dataset, BPB (bits per byte), capability deltas vs ember trained model on matched eval set
decisive_experiment.kill_condition: baseline NLL delta >= -0.05 nats (insufficient floor; frontier baseline must show >=0.06 advantage)

verdicts.reason: NLL deltas are reported but no tokens-to-capability-point crossing metric or tokens-per-eval-point efficiency binding exists. This is a critical missing measurement for the barrier's core claim.
verdicts.covering_evidence: Audit states 'NLL deltas reported but no tokens-to-capability-point crossing metric'; measured_position row 1 gives NLL only, not efficiency-per-token metric

decisive_experiment.intervention: Track token count to capability plateau across training trajectory (checkpoint eval at steps 50/100/200/500/766/target-loss)
decisive_experiment.measurement: tokens_to_target_loss (loss threshold: eval_loss_fp32 <= 9.5 nats; secondary: accuracy points on MMLU/GSM8K), efficiency ratio vs frontier (tokens-per-capability-point)
decisive_experiment.kill_condition: tokens_per_point >= 10x frontier baseline (proves local hardware too constrained for capability parity)

verdicts.reason: Tokenizer is frozen (sha256 6923a52...) but no tokens-per-eval metric exists. Issue #695 notes tokenizer gap but quantification is absent.
verdicts.covering_evidence: Issue #695 commit d1cce0f references 'eval scoring-window (math500 + AC2 smoke + tokenizer gap)' but no measurement receipt found

decisive_experiment.intervention: Evaluate current frozen tokenizer (sha256 6923a52) vs reference tokenizer (tiktoken/GPT-4 level) on same eval data
decisive_experiment.measurement: avg tokens per eval item, BPB impact, tokens-to-capability crossing vs reference
decisive_experiment.kill_condition: efficiency delta < 0.01 BPB (tokenizer is neutral; no lever)

verdicts.reason: Parameter-golf identified n-gram as sole robust survivor (+0.080 BPB, CI [0.06,0.10]) but zero ember receipt exists. This is a parameter-free floor that should be implemented as a reference.
verdicts.covering_evidence: Audit claims 'zero ember receipt'; field_levers row 1 cites 'parameter-golf sole frontier survivor' but no corresponding issue or PR in ember

decisive_experiment.intervention: Implement n-gram/PPM backoff decoder on frozen eval-suite-v1, per parameter-golf guidance (byte-level blending, zero learnable parameters)
decisive_experiment.measurement: NLL/BPB vs neural model, capability deltas on eval sets
decisive_experiment.kill_condition: NLL delta < +0.06 nats (lower CI of golf estimate; baseline too weak to be useful)

verdicts.reason: Parameter-golf identified int6 symmetric 6-bit + STE as optimal during search but ember uses only int8/binary. No int6 checkpoint export or validation exists on external suite.
verdicts.covering_evidence: Audit: 'golf identified int6 sweet spot but ember int8-only/binary unverified; no checkpoint export proof on external suite'; no issue filed; no PR for int6 conversion

decisive_experiment.intervention: Post-training QAT of trained checkpoint with int6 symmetric quantization (STE per golf guidance), on frozen eval-suite-v1
decisive_experiment.measurement: eval_loss_fp32 vs quantized_loss_int6, memory footprint reduction, artifact size vs 16MB target constraint
decisive_experiment.kill_condition: loss delta >= +0.5 nats OR memory footprint > 16MB OR symmetry_error > 1e-3 (quantization too lossy)

verdicts.reason: Parameter-golf phase-3 identified TTT (Test-Time Training) adaptation variant as promising. Issue #400 (opened 2026-06-25) exists but zero ember receipt of TTT on training or eval surface.
verdicts.covering_evidence: Audit: 'golf flagged adaptation variant but zero receipt of TTT on ember training or eval surface'; issue #400 ttt open but no linked PR or receipts

decisive_experiment.intervention: Implement per-document TTT adaptation (eval-time only; zero-cost training; SLOT-based per golf phase-3 guidance)
decisive_experiment.measurement: capability deltas on eval documents with TTT vs baseline, NLL improvement per document
decisive_experiment.kill_condition: delta < +0.01 nats (adaptation too weak; insufficient for claim)

verdicts.reason: No ablation isolating real-growth vs depth-recurrence contributions exists at matched FLOPs. This is a critical unattacked ablation for understanding the efficiency barrier.
verdicts.covering_evidence: Audit explicitly lists: 'no ablation isolating real-growth vs depth-recurrence on matched FLOPs per golf guidance'; deferred-ledger row 15 cgrow-v3-followups cites this as needed work

decisive_experiment.intervention: Train matched-FLOP variants: real-growth (H increase) vs depth-recurrence-only (add layers at fixed width) at iso-FLOP budget, 50K step runs each
decisive_experiment.measurement: eval_loss at matched FLOP compute budget, capability-per-token efficiency (tokens to target loss), H0 component attribution
decisive_experiment.kill_condition: no significant isolation (p > 0.05 on loss delta) OR recurrence uniformly dominates real-growth (disproves the growth lever)

verdicts.target: field_lever: n-gram/PPM byte-level blending (zero-parameter capability floor)
verdicts.reason: Parameter-golf identified this as sole frontier survivor. No issue filed. Zero-parameter inference-time blending is feasible locally and provides an unmeasured baseline for capability-per-token claims.
verdicts.covering_evidence: Field_levers row 1 cites parameter-golf +0.080 BPB (p<0.0001), described as 'composable with neural output at inference-time cost only'; no corresponding issue or PR

decisive_experiment.intervention: Implement n-gram/PPM blending at inference time (probability mixing with neural model, no retraining)
decisive_experiment.measurement: ensemble NLL/BPB on frozen eval-suite-v1, inference-time cost, capability deltas
decisive_experiment.kill_condition: blending efficiency gain < +0.03 BPB (below golf's CI lower bound; insufficient lever)

verdicts.target: field_lever: int6 QAT symmetric 6-bit + STE checkpoint compression
verdicts.reason: Parameter-golf identified int6 as optimal for post-training quantization. Direct bearing on 16MB artifact-size constraint in field challenge. No ember implementation or validation exists.
verdicts.covering_evidence: Field_levers row 2 cites 'parameter-golf sweet-spot (int8 ∆=-0.200, int6 robust)' and 'direct bearing on artifact-size constraint (16MB target)'; no issue filed for int6 implementation

decisive_experiment.intervention: QAT post-training quantization to int6 with STE, on trained checkpoint
decisive_experiment.measurement: loss delta, artifact file size, VRAM footprint reduction, capability-per-token efficiency
decisive_experiment.kill_condition: loss delta >= +0.5 nats OR final artifact > 16MB OR STE_error > 1e-2 (quantization fails constraint)
